meta.title: Radianite — Lightweight VALORANT Companion App
meta.description: Radianite is a lightweight VALORANT companion app for streamers and players who want cleaner match presence and an easy OBS rank overlay.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.api.question: Do I need a Riot API key?
faq.api.answer: No. Radianite is designed around your local Riot Client and active VALORANT session.
faq.password.question: Does this ask for my Riot password?
faq.password.answer: No. Radianite does not need your Riot password. It reads local session information from the Riot Client already running on your PC.
faq.closed.question: Why does the app say Riot Client is closed?
faq.closed.answer: Start Riot Client first. If VALORANT is not running yet, Radianite may show a waiting or partial status until the game session becomes available.
faq.obs.question: How do I add the overlay to OBS?
faq.obs.answer: Copy the overlay URL from Radianite, open OBS, add a Browser Source, and paste the URL. Keep Radianite running while streaming.
faq.discord.question: Does Discord Rich Presence require Discord to be open?
faq.discord.answer: Yes. Discord Rich Presence works through the Discord desktop app, so Discord must be running.
faq.rules.question: Is this allowed by Riot?
faq.rules.answer: Radianite is intended to be a local companion and overlay tool. You are responsible for following Riot's terms and any tournament or platform rules that apply to you.
